    FAQ

    Questions about our GST and tax tools

    View all FAQs →
    Are Taxzentic tools free to use?

    Yes. Taxzentic provides free GST and income-tax calculators, lookups and guides that you can open directly from the site.

    Can I use a calculator result to file a return?

    Treat a calculator result as an estimate based on the details you enter. Review the tool’s method and sources, confirm the rule applies to your facts and tax period, and verify filing details through the official portal or a qualified tax professional.

    Where do formulas and tax references come from?

    Relevant tool pages show the calculation method and source references where available. Check the cited official material for the tax period, classification and facts that apply to your case.

    What can I find on Taxzentic?

    Explore GST and income-tax calculators, GST rate and HSN/SAC lookups, GSTIN checks, and explainers on common tax tasks. Use the search box or browse the tool catalogue to find a page for your question.

    Does the GST calculator choose the correct rate for my product?

    No. The GST calculator applies the rate you select. A rate finder or code lookup can help with research, but confirm the product or service classification and current rate using applicable official schedules and notifications.

    Which financial year or tax year does a calculator cover?

    Check the period, assumptions, and last-updated information on the individual tool page. Tax rules can differ by period, so match the calculator to the year and facts involved and confirm them with current official guidance.

    Are my details always processed only in my browser?

    Data handling depends on the tool. Some calculations run in your browser, while optional AI features may send the fields you submit to a server and AI provider. Read the tool’s privacy note and the Privacy Policy before entering sensitive information.

    Do Taxzentic tools submit returns or payments for me?

    No. The calculators and lookups provide estimates or reference information; they do not submit a GST or income-tax return or make a payment on your behalf.

    Clear data practices

    Many tools process inputs in your browser. The AI notice tool sends submitted details to our server and Groq to prepare a draft.

    Sources and methods

    Tool pages explain their calculation method and list source references where available. Tax rules can change, so confirm current requirements.

    Tools without an account

    Use the available calculators and references without creating an account. Check each tool for its scope and data handling.
